visual_text: Amplification did not change total scores in small studies. Record the adaptations anyway.
Record the adaptations with the score
In 301 older adults, people with hearing or sight loss passed the MoCA less often, even after scores were adjusted.
In two small studies, amplification did not change the total score. In one, it helped word recall.
Dupuis et al., 2015; Shen et al., 2020; Saunders et al., 2018
alt_text: Checklist before a cognitive test: hearing aids in, glasses on, quiet room, amplifier, large print, and record adaptations with the score. Notes: 301 older adults with hearing or sight loss passed the MoCA less often; amplification did not change total scores.
design_instructions: Single card checklist with emphasised last row and two note panels.
